profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at American Airlines

positions.title: Lead Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Working on integration with vendor product using Azure Cloud Services
•	Explored Azure storage explorer and Azure service bus to store and retrieve the data
•	Worked on listening and sending JMS messages to send the events to systems
•	Working as a lead developer to translate the requirements to the technical documents, establish specific solutions and leading the efforts including programming and testing
•	Ensure development stack is aligned with framework designed by software engineering team

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
•	Managing technical solutions and production deployments to deliver the features
•	Supervise and lead a team of 6 developers from reviewing code to solutioning the requirements
•	Actively work with business partners to map out the business requirements to technical solution
•	Work with Business Analyst to create technical JIRA stories with clear Acceptance Criteria
•	Investigate and resolve production issues with SRE team to provide quick turnaround
•	Collaboration with cross-functional teams to coordinate changes & implement contract testing
•	Working with DevOps to setup the pipeline and UI app/API deployment requirements
•	Maintaining daily continuous integration/delivery pipeline, coordinating production deployments once the feature is completely developed and ready to go Live/to market
•	Constantly analyze the adoption of new tech versions for Angular, Java and Spring Boot

positions.title: Senior Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed REST Web services in spring boot and UI pages/components in Angular version 7/8
•	Maintained code quality by writing clean, scalable and well-tested code
•	Implemented different design patterns like strategy, template in Java
•	Used streams and Lambda expressions of Java8/11 to store and process the data
•	Implemented Apache Kafka listener and producer for handling messaging services
•	Build database scripts to create the data reports to verify client details and created cursors/SQL queries to align the data
•	Worked closely with TechLead and Architect to design a solution and implement a feature according to business requirement
•	Presented fully developed features in sprint demos to stakeholders
•	Used Jenkins and UCD to track the build progress and deployment to testing environments
•	Continuously monitored the application/API performances on Dynatrace. Also, analyzing API calls in case of failures to investigate the root cause
•	Actively used kibana to explore and visualize production data for investigation purpose
•	Actively worked with Postman and swagger to test the API
•	Regularly monitor sonarqube to avoid any programming bugs to maintain coding standards

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Worked with British Telecom(BT) to maintain data alignment between interacting systems, resolve issues in real time
• Developed UNIX Shell scripts and JavaScripts to automate existing procedures, reducing man-hours by 35%
• Maintained online portal for BT customers using Java to track account information and provide customer support 
• Created PL/SQL procedures, performed all levels of testing on sprint deliverables, provided required documentation
• Developed system design, coding and database operation best practices to adhere to system efficiency requirements

positions.title: Computer Science Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a portal for merchants to post deals online and android app for users to be notified of those deals
• Implemented GEO-fencing feature using Google APIs to filter shops and deals based on location and user interest
• Provided social media integration for merchants and users via Facebook, WhatsApp and Instagram APIs

Tools & Technologies Used:
 - Android, Java
 - HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, SQLite and MySQL Database

•Implemented multiple game levels and sound effects.

projects.title: E-Course
projects.description:
·   Developed a website to connect tutors and students for learning purpose using JSP and JAVA in Agile SDLC
·   Deployed the project to university sever using Jenkins and updated a regular story in Trello

Tools & Technologies Used:
-JAVA, JSP, Bootstraps, Jenkins, Git, Maven and Trello
